info.prompt: A cyber-gothic autopsy theater where surgeons in blackened gold robes dissect a glowing neon corpse, its ribcage splayed open to reveal cyan-stained dice embedded in crystalline organs, the surgical lamps casting long magenta shadows that flicker to the rhythm of a flatlining heartbeat, the entire scene framed by skeletal arches pulsing with synaptic data streams that drip like liquid code onto the sterile void-black floor.
